items.exampleEn: Let's postpone our trip until the weather gets better.
items.exampleZh: 我們把旅行延到天氣好一點再去吧。

items.exampleEn: I called the hotel to inquire about room prices.
items.exampleZh: 我打電話給飯店詢問房價。

items.exampleEn: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the show.
items.exampleZh: 表演結束時，觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

items.exampleEn: Her dedication to her work impressed everyone.
items.exampleZh: 她對工作的投入讓大家印象深刻。

items.exampleEn: The weather alternated between sun and rain all week.
Please disconnect the printer before you move it.
items.exampleZh: 搬動印表機之前，請先把它的線拔掉。

items.exampleEn: I only had time to skim the report before the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 開會前我只有時間大略瀏覽報告。

items.exampleEn: Can you help me inflate this beach ball?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我把這顆海灘球充氣嗎？

items.sentenceEn: If you have any questions, please inquire at the front desk.
items.sentenceZh: 如有任何疑問，請向櫃台詢問。

items.audioEn: Because of the storm, tonight's concert has been postponed until Saturday.
items.audioZh: 由於暴風雨，今晚的音樂會延到星期六。
options: It moved to another city far away

items.sentenceEn: My internet keeps disconnecting whenever it rains.
items.sentenceZh: 每次下雨，我的網路就一直斷線。

items.sentenceEn: At the factory, day and night shifts alternate every two weeks.
items.sentenceZh: 這家工廠的日班和夜班每兩週輪替一次。

items.stemEn: I didn't read the whole article; I just ____ it on the train.
items.stemZh: 我沒有讀完整篇文章，只是在火車上大略瀏覽了一下。

items.stemEn: Everyone thanked the old volunteer for his years of ____.
items.stemZh: 大家感謝那位年長志工多年來的奉獻。

items.passageEn: Ms. Lin worked at our company for thirty years, and her retirement party was a big event. It was originally planned for May, but it was postponed because the hall was being repaired. On the day, we inflated balloons and hung them across the room. During the party, our manager gave a speech about Ms. Lin's dedication, and everyone clapped for a long time. Ms. Lin said she would finally disconnect from work emails and travel. When someone inquired about her plans, she said she would alternate between visiting her daughter in Canada and her son in Tainan. She joked that from now on, she would only skim the news.
items.passageZh: 林女士在我們公司工作了三十年，她的退休派對是一件大事。派對原本預定在五月，但因為大廳在整修而延期。當天，我們吹了氣球，掛滿整個會場。派對上，經理致詞讚揚林女士的奉獻，大家鼓掌了好久。林女士說，她終於可以不再收工作信件，好好去旅行了。有人問起她的計畫，她說會輪流去探望住在加拿大的女兒和住在台南的兒子。她還開玩笑說，從現在起她看新聞只會大略瀏覽。

questions.questionZh: 林女士退休後打算做什麼？
options: 每週回公司兼職當顧問

items.promptZh: 因為下雨，比賽延到下週舉行。
referenceEn: Because of the rain, the game was postponed until next week.
The game has been postponed to next week because of the rain.
rubricZh: postpone 常用被動（例如 was postponed、has been postponed），後面可接 until 或 to＋時間
「因為下雨」可寫 because of the rain、due to the rain 等

items.instructionZh: 用 alternate 造一個句子，說說你和別人輪流做的事，或你輪流做的兩件事。
referenceEn: My sister and I alternate washing the dishes every night.
I alternate between running and swimming during the week.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 alternate，當動詞表示「輪流、交替」（例如 alternate doing…、alternate between A and B）
